summary: Anthropic announced an additional $20 million donation to Public First Action, bringing its total contribution to $40 million to support public education and advocacy for AI safety policy, including its Advanced AI Framework and export control tightening.

mechanisms.reason: Anthropic states it supports policy efforts to tighten chip export controls, but this is advocacy for future policy rather than an enacted restriction.
mechanisms.quote: we support policy efforts to tighten export controls on advanced chips and semiconductor manufacturing equipment and to curb illicit model access and distillation attacks
